title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Gonna tweet this out in like 10 min... “For those asking, I don’t know if there will be a TigerFest for C.J. Cron and Jonathan Schoop to attend.”
I don’t know anything and TBH, given the timing it really feels like it’s gonna get some of us in trouble
I might call Ron and just ask him
Called at 11:45, didn’t answer. Texted at 1:30, emphasized “!”, he says, “Everything ok? What’s up? I am at a family event.”

All I’m trying to do is put in an interview request for Kenny Graham for a Sunday story (so they can deny it in good notice) and also say, “Look, what’s the deal with TigerFest on or off the record or do you want me to keep sending pot-shot tweets out about it not happening”
But then I fear I may be threatening people again. Ho-Ho-Ho, Greg
I feel attacked and blackmailed. I’m going to Tigers legal counsel.
Emphasized “I feel attacked and blackmailed. I’m going to Tigers legal counsel.”
Schoop’s 3 pm conference call got pushed back to 4 after 15 minutes because Ben couldn’t get him on the phone
Then at 4, it took another 10 minutes
I should’ve just cut up the audio of all 3-4 times Ben was like, “Jonathan, are you on the call?” and he wasn’t
